limits: Alternate compositions of named entries only. No elements package or workspace source aliases.
Native semantic and computed-style scenarios only; manual AT, native clipboard transport, SSR/hydration and full theme visual acceptance remain separate.

runtime.policy: Locally resolved browser installations and executable bytes; no inference from package version alone.

earlierAttempts.boundary: Strict test compilation needed explicit ShadowRoot narrowing; no browser assertions ran.
22 passed,1 failed,157 not run: generic overlay rules loaded after palette rules displaced the narrow dialog. Corrected stylesheet composition order.
180 browser and37 Node cases passed before adding the final inventory binding assertion.

buildReuse.reason: This batch changes packed qualification fixtures and source documentation, not the docs application or library runtime.

limitations: Ten additional entries have bounded native composition qualification;88/110 entries qualified and22 remain pending.
Matching recipe semantics remain application-owned. Overlay styles precede palette styles in both deliveries; the failed narrow-placement run is retained. No owning-element runtime changed.

Nested menu hover, remote filtering, every export in selection/surfaces, actual IME, physical touch, retail browser products, manual AT, full SSR/hydration and separate-owner acceptance remain outside these scenarios.
WebKit uses native Option+Tab sequential navigation; engine forced-color assertions are not manual platform acceptance. Historical external CSS-authoring rerun remains retired, never passed.
